rows.notes: The study is a literature review (Section 2 describes a database search of 2009-2019 papers and summarises them); it reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. It discusses advanced control strategies and water saving only by citing other work, so it cannot provide primary evidence for this claim.

Review article; no primary result. Statements on closed-loop control handling disturbances and uncertainty (Sections 5.1-5.2.3) are narrative summaries of cited literature, not the authors' own findings.

Review article; no own data. Claims about reduced over-application and improved timing/amount decisions are drawn from cited works (e.g. Montesano et al. 2016, Tseng et al. 2018, Lefkowitz 2019), not from any result of the review itself.

Review article; no primary evidence. The review does not discuss reallocation of saved water or distinguish water use efficiency gains from withdrawal reductions; this content is not present in the study at all.

Review article; no own data. The review notes in passing that ANN/controller accuracy depends on data quality and sensor calibration costs (Section 5.2.2.2, 5.2), but these are narrative remarks, not results on sensor drift, communication dropouts or coverage degrading performance.

Review article; no primary result on advanced control reducing excess irrigation. Conditions such as reliable monitoring and good-quality sensor data are stated as general recommendations drawn from the literature, not from the authors' own findings.
Review article; no own data. No result on risk management is reported; discussion of robustness to disturbances in MPC and fuzzy/PID controllers is a synthesis of cited studies.

notes: The cited study is a narrative literature review (Computers and Electronics in Agriculture, 2020) of monitoring and control strategies for precision irrigation. Its only 'own' content is a bibliometric tally of selected papers (Figs 1-3); Fig. 6 shows photographs of the authors' orchard experiments but no results are reported. Q1 is therefore 'no' for all claim rows, and Q2-Q9 follow as 'no'. Full text appears complete, including reference list.
